name: Prism Ark Lovelove Maximum!
original_name: プリズム・アーク らぶらぶマキシマム！
source:
This item features seven after-stories of the Prism heroines. Each character has her own story. Also, it includes a mini game and a 3D movie.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106111227/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008848]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
本作收錄了《Prism Ark》七位女主角各自的後日談，每位角色都有獨立的故事。此外，遊戲還包含一個小遊戲和一段3D影片。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106111227/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008848]Eroge Shop[/url]]
